name: Kolap Restaurant
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul, Frogtown / Summit-University (601 N. Dale St.)
whatItIs: Family-owned Cambodian restaurant opened in October 2003 by a couple who fled the Khmer Rouge; now run by their eldest son. Sour soups, prohok ktees, lot chha, loc lac.
evidence: Own website lists weekly hours (closed Monday; Tue-Sat 10-7, Sun 10-6) and online ordering; site footer reads 2021. A Nov. 12, 2024 review describes a recent meal there (myannoyingopinions.com).

name: Cheng Heng Restaurant
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul, University Avenue (448 University Ave. W.)
whatItIs: Long-running Cambodian restaurant described by food writers as the Twin Cities' leading Cambodian restaurant; photo menu of loth chha, banh xiung, nhum salad.
evidence: Latest opened account is a May 9, 2023 review (myannoyingopinions.com); Mpls.St.Paul Magazine listing is undated; no own website or 2025-2026 dated post was found.

name: Twin Tiger (Sina War)
whatItIs: Food brand of Cambodian American cook Sina War, co-host of the April 30, 2025 Immigrant Kitchen dinner of BIPOC Foodways Alliance.
evidence: Brand named in a 2025 BIPOC Foodways newsletter and MPR News (April 9, 2025); no brand website or current sales page was opened.

name: International Translation Bureau
whatItIs: Firm whose president and CEO was Sokunthea Bentley of Eagan, per a 2005 governor's appointment release.
evidence: Only source is a 2005 press release; no current listing was found.

name: UCAM Adult Day Services (United Cambodian Association of Minnesota)
neighborhoodOrCity: Mendota Heights (1385 Mendota Heights Rd., Suite 500)
whatItIs: Adult day program opened Oct. 16, 2014 for Cambodian elders and people with disabilities; accepts EW, CADI, DD, BI waivers, Alternative Care, ECS and private pay; serves seven metro counties.
evidence: Own site, checked Oct. 31, 2026, lists current staff (president and CEO, center director), services, phone and address; 211 United Way listing (2026 copyright) describes the elder programs.

name: Wattanak Dance Troupe
whatItIs: Cambodian classical and folk dance troupe and classes, founded by Master Yousedy Peov (2008 per troupe; 2000 per Theater Mu).
evidence: Own site shows 2026 copyright and current staff; Southern Theater listed its performances July 10-11, 2026.
